description: Counts and dollars over every row in a window, grouped by sector or industry group x week or month, for 'what is the market doing' questions by sector or over time. One call covers every row rather than a screen's first page, returned as paged cells (default 25 cells; nextCursor pages the rest; each page is kept under 30,000 characters). Families: dealing (director buys $, sales $, net $, trade counts; tax-on-vesting sales shown apart, not in net), guidance (upgrades/downgrades/reaffirmed/initiated/withdrawn, split by metricClass), raises (count, A$m sought and completed, median stated discount), ma (new bids, proposals, signed schemes, median premium), distress (administrations, receiverships, liquidations, credit-rating downgrades), holders (substantial-holder increases vs decreases by holder type, stock lending left out). Every cell carries examples: up to 3 rows behind it with symbol and docKey. Example: director buys vs sales by sector since 1 Sep -> groupBy='sector', families='dealing'. Results carry the caveats alongside the numbers. Free.

cursor.description: Next page: the nextCursor from the previous response. A non-null nextCursor means more cells follow; null is the last page.

groupBy.description: Comma-separated: one of sector|industryGroup and/or one of week|month (default 'sector,week'). 'sector' alone = one row per sector for the whole window.

limit.description: Max cells per page, 1-100 (default 25). A heavy cell shrinks the page further so the response stays under 30,000 characters.

sector.description: Optional: one sector, industry group or tag.
